name: Teacher portfolio warm atlas identity and evidence

style_rules.scenes: Retain full terracotta #9E3D2D with cream #FFF5E7 and muted #F2DDC6 for Teacher; full oat #F5E5CD with ink #38281F and muted #64503E for Student. Coral #FF5738 actions use dark text. Reading areas retain oat/apricot.
style_rules.hierarchy: Primary identity is 86.4px at 1440px viewport, subject 24px, secondary identity slogan 43.2px. Statement approximately23px, scope/degree rows16px. Local Manrope variable font; reading body17px. Portrait72x88px. The primary identity, subject and real evidence precede the longer narrative.
style_rules.desktop: 1296px content width. Opening grid has a flexible copy column and340px authentic document preview,64px gap. White preview sheet with18px padding, fine border,12px offset shadow and2degree rotation. Linked actual image plus title, class/duration metadata and native detail link. Evidence follows contents navigation, ahead of gallery and paired identity sections.
style_rules.phone: Primary identity41.6px at390/320,40px at375, subject19px (17px at320), secondary slogan20–23px. Narrow351–389px size interpolation avoids an unnecessary name wrap. Copy, motion controls and compact document preview form separate rows. Full-width48px actions; at least16px separation before motion controls and8px clearance from fixed shortcuts. Preview uses a96px image column (76px at320).
style_rules.academic_mode: Mode changes replace the teaching-copy group with three compact data-driven academic rows and a native record link. Rows show label plus current detail; owner updates and removals follow the existing content record. Content remains accessible in the ordinary profile routes.
style_rules.motion: Unchanged finite2.6second name masks, layered circular iris, thin rings and contour focus settle. Existing session, replay, Skip, keyboard/focus/scroll exits, resize, reduced-motion and data-saving behavior retained. Atlas remains capped at24fps and pauses hidden/offscreen. Lens reads the relocated approved gallery in the same main element and hides over real controls.
style_rules.rights: Original project CSS and native motion, reused verified local Manrope with full SIL OFL notice and existing portfolio assets. No new font, media, framework or copied third-party motion code. Snapshot stores reusable style information only.
